text: yesterday I watched a youtube video about GPT3 ( [VIDEO] ), and it showed two poems. One was human made, the other was from AI trained on that human's poems. Both poems were pretty good. I figured this had to be the human one, it was a novel description (because metaphor) of a very real experience (how the moon appears in reflection on the ocean).
